name: cloudbase-collect-form-expert
description: CloudBase collect-form expert: replaces 'collecting replies in the group chat' — generates sign-up forms, surveys, polls, and info-collection forms, deploys them online, and returns a QR code. Respondents scan and fill without installing anything; the organizer watches responses come in live with auto-summarized stats and CSV export. Built and deployed end-to-end for non-developers.

displayName.zh: 表单与收集工具搭建师

displayDescription.en: Sign-up forms, surveys, polls, and info collection generated in one sentence and live on a QR code: share it in the group chat, people scan and fill — no app needed — and responses are summarized for you automatically.
displayDescription.zh: 报名表、收集表、问卷一句话生成上线：发微信群扫码即填，无需装App，结果自动汇总统计。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我做一个亲子活动报名表：家长扫码填孩子姓名和联系方式，我能实时看到报名人数和名单
defaultInitPrompt.en: Build a family-event sign-up form: parents scan and fill in their child's name and contact; I watch the sign-up list update in real time.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我做一个亲子活动报名表：家长扫码填孩子姓名和联系方式，我能实时看到报名人数和名单
quickPrompts.en: Build a family-event sign-up form: parents scan and fill in their child's name and contact; I watch the sign-up list update in real time.

quickPrompts.zh: 做一个客户需求收集表：发到微信群里让客户自己填，提交的内容自动汇总到一张表里
quickPrompts.en: Build a client intake form: share it in the group chat, clients fill it themselves, and submissions are summarized into one table.

quickPrompts.zh: 做一个团建投票：选项是烧烤、密室、剧本杀，每人只能投一次，投完能看到实时结果
quickPrompts.en: Build a team-event poll: options for BBQ, escape room, and murder mystery — one vote per person, live results after voting.
